import pytest
from project_cobalt.discount import apply_discount  # Adjust the import path as needed


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "price, code, expected",
    [
        # SAVE10 cases (10% off)
        (100.0, "SAVE10", 90.0),
        (50.0, "SAVE10", 45.0),
        (0.0, "SAVE10", 0.0),
        (19.99, "SAVE10", 17.991),  # Note: floating point precision may require approx
        
        # SAVE20 cases (20% off)
        (100.0, "SAVE20", 80.0),
        (50.0, "SAVE20", 40.0),
        (0.0, "SAVE20", 0.0),
        
        # Unknown codes (no discount)
        (100.0, "INVALID", 100.0),
        (100.0, "", 100.0),
        (100.0, "save10", 100.0),   # Case-sensitive check
        (100.0, "SAVE30", 100.0),
        (100.0, None, 100.0),       # If None is handled gracefully; otherwise this might raise TypeError depending on implementation
        
        # Edge cases
        (-100.0, "SAVE10", -90.0),  # Negative price behavior depends on spec; assuming linear application
    ],
)
def test_apply_discount(price, code, expected):
    result = apply_discount(price, code)
    assert result == pytest.approx(expected, abs=1e-9)


def test_apply_discount_type_check():
    """Ensure function returns float."""
    result = apply_discount(100.0, "SAVE10")
    assert isinstance(result, float)
